title: cps-okf — Bundle root index.md frontmatter (OKF-CPS profile v0.1)
description: Frontmatter of the ROOT index.md. Per base OKF §6 the ONLY field permitted in an index.md frontmatter is okf_version, so that is all this carries. The organizational glossary (axis 5) does NOT live here — it lives on a Glossary concept (glossary.md), where arbitrary frontmatter is allowed. See concept.schema.json#/properties/cps/properties/glossary.

okf_version.description: Base-OKF version this bundle targets, e.g. '0.1'. The only frontmatter key allowed in a root index.md.
